scenicChapters.title: Olympic Peninsula Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: For 36 km this is Olympic Peninsula Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Olympic Peninsula Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 57 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

olympic-peninsula-loop-hurricane-ridge-r.story: A one-way ride of 244 km, Port Angeles to the finish - roughly 3 h 28 in the saddle. On the way it passes Lake Crescent and Forks. The highest point is about 1,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
